metadata.title: Strong $G_2$-structures with torsion: a survey and new examples
metadata.abstract: This article has two main parts. The first consists of a brief survey of $G_2$-structures with torsion, namely $G_2$-structures admitting a $G_2$-connection with totally skew-symmetric torsion. We focus primarily on the strong condition that the associated torsion $3$-form is closed. We review their basic properties and their connections with the heterotic $G_2$ system, generalized geometry, and six-dimensional geometry. In the second part, we construct two complete cohomogeneity-one strong $G_2T$-structures on $\mathbb{R}\times S^3\times S^3$ with non-zero closed and co-closed characteristic torsion, and non-vanishing characteristic Ricci tensor. Both have an asymptotically cylindrical end; at the other end, the first is asymptotically conical (AC), with a torsion-free $G_2$ cone as its asymptotic model, while the second is asymptotically locally conical (ALC), with a constant-length circle bundle over a Calabi--Yau cone as its asymptotic model. We investigate the induced $SU(3)$-structures on their circle quotients and show that they are globally conformally almost Kähler and globally conformally Kähler, respectively. To the best of our knowledge, these provide the first complete strong $G_2T$-structures whose underlying metrics are not locally Riemannian products.

analysis.topic: 黎曼、亚黎曼、Finsler及特殊几何结构
analysis.workSummary: 梳理强带扭 G₂ 结构，并在 ℝ×S³×S³ 构造两个完备共齐性一实例。
analysis.breakthrough: 两支共齐性一解均在一端渐近柱面；另一端分别趋于 Bryant–Salamon 锥和以 Calabi–Yau 锥为底的 ALC 模型。特征扭率由两个 S³ 的体积形式之和给出，作者计算两例 Levi-Civita 代数均为 so(7)。
analysis.limitations: 存在性在 ℝ×S³×S³ 的给定对称设定中建立。补读两条定理及渐近分析，未独立复算完整曲率与 holonomy。
